# Fix or Refund?

> Broken product? Check your next step. A private guide to possible seller remedies and repair options—not legal advice.

Independent information, not a government service or legal advice. This release has not been certified by a qualified legal reviewer.

Greek provisions are recorded for review, not certified. Current conclusions use cautious EU-baseline information. No national-specific entitlement is generated until approved review.

Your checker answers and letter are processed locally in your browser. They are not submitted to a case-data service.

Historical source-review record: 2026-10-30. Qualified legal review pending · no named reviewer supplied
